{{Terminology Infobox |image = System Signal Search.png|System Icon Signal Search.png|Icon |type = Game Systems |group = Monetization |group2 = Menus }} '''Signal Searches''' are the main {{W|Gacha game|gacha}} system in ''[[Zenless Zone Zero]]'', and are the primary method for obtaining new [[Agent]]s, [[W-Engine]]s and [[Bangboo]]. Players can unlock Signal Searching for Agents and W-Engines after having completed the [[Prologue]] [[Commission]]: [[The Ultimate Collectibles]]. Signal Searching for Bangboo becomes available after the player has unlocked [[Turbo Remodeling Shop]] on [[Sixth Street]]. Signal Searches are divided into different "Channels", with each channel providing a different type of reward. ==Stable Channel== [[File:Item Master Tape.png|right|100px|thumb|[[Master Tape]]]] {{Main|Stable Channel}} The '''Stable Channel''' is a channel that offers permanent signal searches, which currently solely refers to [[Star-Studded Cast]].
It offers a non-changing, limited selection of {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank Agents and {{Rank|S}}-Rank W-Engines, while also allowing players to obtain {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank Agents and {{Rank|A}}-Rank W-Engines. ==Exclusive Channel== [[File:Item Encrypted Master Tape.png|right|100px|thumb|[[Encrypted Master Tape]]]] {{Main|Exclusive Channel}} {{See Also|Exclusive Rescreening}} The '''Exclusive Channel''' is a channel that offers limited-time signal searches, with those available changing twice per [[Version]] (commonly referred to as "First Half" and "Second Half").
The signal searches available on the exclusive channel will typically feature an {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank Agent that cannot be obtained outside of their respective signal search, while also featuring 2 {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank Agents with a drop-rate boost. * In the Exclusive Channel, the S-Rank Signal Customization feature allows Proxies to select 6 {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank Agents as their customized Agents and inherit the same data and drop rate rules as the non-featured {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank Agents in the Exclusive Channel. If the S-Rank Signal obtained is not the featured {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank Agent, it is guaranteed to be one of the 6 selected {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank Agents. * In the Exclusive Channel, the A-Rank Rate Up feature allows Proxies to select 2 {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank Agents as the current boosted {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank Agents, inheriting the same data and drop rate rules from the previous {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank rate-up Agents. If the Proxy does not customize the rate-up Agents, the default {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank Agents of the current Exclusive Channel will serve as the current {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank rate-up Agents. {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank and {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank Agents, alongside {{Rank|A}}-Rank W-Engines that can be found in the ''Stable Channel'' are also available in these signal searches. ==W-Engine Channel== [[File:Item Encrypted Master Tape.png|right|100px|thumb|[[Encrypted Master Tape]]]] {{Main|W-Engine Channel}} {{See Also|W-Engine Reverberation}} The '''W-Engine Channel''' is a channel that offers limited-time signal searches, with those available changing twice per [[Version]] (commonly referred to as "First Half" and "Second Half").
The signal searches available on the w-engine channel will typically feature an {{Rank|S}}-Rank W-Engine that cannot be obtained outside of their respective signal search, while also featuring 2 {{Rank|A}}-Rank W-Engines with a drop-rate boost. * In the W-Engine Channel, the S-Rank Signal Customization feature allows Proxies to select 6 {{Rank|S}}-Rank W-Engines as their customized W-Engines and inherit the same data and drop rate rules as the non-featured {{Rank|S}}-Rank W-Engines in the W-Engine Channel. If the S-Rank Signal obtained is not the featured {{Rank|S}}-Rank W-Engine, it is guaranteed to be one of the 6 selected {{Rank|S}}-Rank W-Engines. * In the W-Engine Channel, the A-Rank Rate Up feature allows Proxies to select 2 {{Rank|A}}-Rank W-Engines as the current boosted {{Rank|A}}-Rank W-Engines, inheriting the same data and drop rate rules from the previous {{Rank|A}}-Rank rate-up W-Engines. If the Proxy does not customize the rate-up W-Engines, the default {{Rank|A}}-Rank W-Engines of the current W-Engine Channel will serve as the current {{Rank|A}}-Rank rate-up W-Engines. {{Rank|S}}-Rank and {{Rank|A}}-Rank W-Engines, alongside {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank Agents that can be found in the ''Stable Channel'' are also available in these signal searches. ==Bangboo Channel== [[File:Item Boopon.png|right|100px|thumb|[[Boopon]]]] {{Main|Bangboo Channel}} The '''Bangboo Channel''' is a channel that offers permanent signal searches, which currently solely refers to [[An Outstanding Partner]].
This is the only channel that offers {{Icon|Bangboo Rank S}}-Rank Combat Bangboo, while also offering many {{Icon|Bangboo Rank A}}-Rank Combat Bangboo. ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Signal Search |zhs = 调频 |zhs_rm = Tiáopín |zht = 調頻 |zht_rm = Tiáopín |ja = 変調 |ja_rm = Henchō |ko = 변조 |es = Sintonización |fr = Recherche de signal |ru = Поиск сигнала |th = ปรับความถี่ |th_rm = Prap Khwamthi |vi = Chỉnh Kênh |de = Signalsuche |id = Cari FM |pt = Busca de Sinal }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.0}} ==Navigation== {{Wiki Navbox}} [[ru:Поиск сигнала]]

{{Custom Tabs |tab1 = Overview |tab2 = History }} {{Terminology Infobox |type= Signal Search Types }} '''Exclusive Channels''' are [[Signal Searches]] that have one promotional S-Rank [[Agent]] and two featured A-Rank Agents. Both the promotional S-Rank and featured A-Rank Agents will have an increased probability for players to signal search for them when compared to the basic rates when the guarantees are factored in. ==Rules== * '''A-Rank drop guarantee:''' If a player does not obtain any A-Rank (or above) signal within 9 signal searches in a row, the 10th signal is ''guaranteed'' to be an A-Rank (or higher) signal. ** This counter will reset if the player obtains any A-Rank signal. * '''Featured A-Rank Agent guarantee:''' Every time a player obtains an A-Rank signal, there is a 50% chance it will be one of the featured A-Rank Agents. ** If the A-Rank signal obtained is ''not'' one of the featured Agents, then the next A-Rank signal obtained is ''guaranteed'' to be one of the featured Agents. ** Thus it requires a ''maximum'' of 20 signal searches to obtain ''one of'' the featured A-Rank Agents. * '''S-Rank drop guarantee:''' If a player does not obtain any S-Rank signal after 89 signal searches, the 90th signal is ''guaranteed'' to be an S-Rank signal. ** This counter will reset if the player obtains any S-Rank signal. ** Exclusive Channels do not contain S-Rank W-Engines in their item pool, as such each S-Rank signal will be an Agent. * '''Promotional S-Rank Agent guarantee:''' Every time a player obtains an S-Rank signal, there is a 50% chance it will be the promotional S-Rank Agent. ** If the S-Rank signal obtained is ''not'' the promotional Agent, the next S-Rank signal is ''guaranteed'' to be the promotional Agent. ** Thus it requires a ''maximum'' of 180 signal searches to guarantee obtaining ''the'' promotional S-Rank Agent. * '''Counter and Guarantee carry-over:''' Each signal search of the same ''type'' shares the above counters and guarantees, this means that your counters for the current Exclusive Channel are carried over to the next Exclusive Channel (but not the W-Engine Channel, Stable Channel or Bangboo Channel). ** For example, if one obtains 89 B/A signals on Exclusive Channel X, then the ''first'' signal on the following promotional Exclusive Channel Y will be a guaranteed S-Rank Agent. ** Likewise if one obtained a non-promotional S-Rank Agent on Exclusive Channel X, then the next S-Rank Agent on Exclusive Channel Y will be guaranteed to be the promotional Agent. ===Custom Search=== * In the Exclusive Channel, the S-Rank Signal Customization feature allows Proxies to select 6 {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank Agents as their customized Agents and inherit the same data and drop rate rules as the non-featured {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank Agents in the Exclusive Channel. If the S-Rank Signal obtained is not the featured {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank Agent, it is guaranteed to be one of the 6 selected {{AgentRank|S}}-Rank Agents. * In the Exclusive Channel, the A-Rank Rate Up feature allows Proxies to select 2 {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank Agents as the current boosted {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank Agents, inheriting the same data and drop rate rules from the previous {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank rate-up Agents. If the Proxy does not customize the rate-up Agents, the default {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank Agents of the current Exclusive Channel will serve as the current {{AgentRank|A}}-Rank rate-up Agents. ===Residual Signal=== {{Transclude|Residual Signal|Acquisition|main=1}} ===Special Invitation Letter=== {{Transclude|Special Invitation Letter|Acquisition|main=1}} ==Current & Upcoming Signal Searches== {{Current Signal Search|Exclusive Channel Signal Searches}} ==List of Exclusive Channels== {{See also|Exclusive Channel/History}} {{Signal Search Series by Category Table|Exclusive Channel|header=Exclusive Channel series}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Exclusive Channel |zhs = 独家频段 |zhs_rm = Dújiā Pínduàn |zht = 獨家頻道 |zht_rm = Dújiā Pínduàn |ja = 独占チャンネル |ja_rm = Dokusen Chaneru |ko = 독점 채널 |es = Canal Exclusivo |fr = Canal exclusif |ru = Выделенный канал |th = Exclusive Channel |vi = Kênh Độc Quyền |de = Exklusiver Kanal |id = FM Eksklusif |pt = Canal Exclusivo }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.0}} ==Navigation== {{Signal Search Navbox}} [[ru:Выделенный канал]]
